public.text: The statement that foundation strength determines whether technology compounds value or adds another silo is directionally correct but too binary. Technologies may deliver local value while remaining only partially integrated.
public.suggestedRevision: Use more measured wording that recognises a continuum of integration, reuse, sustainability, and system-wide value.
